android.desc:
Parallel Live lets you experience the thrill of live streaming while helping you practice speaking, storytelling, and building confidence in a fun, supportive, simulated environment. Step into your own virtual stage and go live to thousands of AI-generated fans who react, comment, and cheer you on in real time.

FEATURES

- Practice Public Speaking: Build confidence by talking to a virtual audience that feels alive.

- Improve Storytelling: Tell stories, share ideas, and watch your virtual fans react with likes and comments.

- Build Confidence: Overcome stage fright and anxiety by streaming in a private, safe, and playful environment.

- Record & Reflect: Capture your live sessions to track your progress and see how your delivery improves.

- Gamified Motivation: Keep your streak alive and climb your way to virtual fame.

Parallel Live is a simulation and entertainment application. All simulated viewers are AI-generated characters and do not represent real people.
